{{Top|leg}}
'''Vandalar City''' was a large, vertical [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Reaper's World/Legends|Reaper's World]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was built out of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and [[formex]]. The upper levels were populated by the wealthy and affluent citizens, while the lower levels were buried in frozen trash and sewage.

The lower levels were energy-poor and very cold, due to the on-going ice age the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] climate was going through. [[Redbeast]]s lived on these levels.
